sections.h2: Jute: India grows about 60% of the world's crop but barely exports it

chart.title: National raw jute output fell from 97.6 to 91.8 lakh bales despite the mandate
chart.sub: National raw jute output, lakh bales of 180 kg each.
chart.source: Figures as cited in the post.

sections.means: India's jute goes almost entirely to a statutory domestic packaging market rather than to export.
sections.todo: Raising the MSP helps farmers directly, but it does not make jute compete on export terms.

sections.h2: Silk: output grew about 60% in a decade, yet India still imports raw silk

chart.title: Raw silk output grew from about 26,000 to 42,033 tonnes between 2014 and 2025-26
chart.source: Central Silk Board, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Total output grew about 60% over the decade, so volume alone does not explain the imports.
sections.todo: Closing the bivoltine supply gap, not adding raw tonnage, is what would reduce silk imports.

sections.h2: Only 11,229 tonnes of India's mulberry silk is the bivoltine grade industry needs

chart.title: Bivoltine silk is a minority of mulberry output, the grade weaving needs
chart.sub: Mulberry silk output in the year reported, tonnes.
chart.source: Central Silk Board, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Most Indian cocoons are multivoltine, which does not substitute cleanly for the bivoltine grade industrial weaving needs.
sections.todo: Breeding for bivoltine cocoons is the fix the post points to, because raw tonnage was never the constraint.

sections.h2: India imports more raw wool than it produces, despite a large sheep flock

chart.title: Raw wool imports in 2023-24 were nearly three times domestic output
chart.sub: Raw wool output and imports, 2023-24, million kg.
chart.source: Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2024; import figure as cited in the post.

sections.means: The wool gap is about grade rather than headcount, since India imports more raw wool by weight than it produces.
sections.todo: Inbreeding-driven quality decline, not sheep numbers, is what the post says needs fixing to cut wool imports.
